name: Bubble Stomp
summary:
Get ready for an adventure packed with jumps, bubbles, and creativity in Bubble Stomp! Here, every obstacle is an opportunity to test your skills and discover new ways to move through stages filled with exciting platforming challenges.

Use temporary bubbles, Ground Pound, and cannons to reach impossible places, cross dangerous areas, and overcome increasingly challenging obstacles. Combine these mechanics in unexpected ways to create new paths, gain momentum, defeat enemies, and reach the final objective.

Across 30 levels, new enemies, hazards, and mechanics are gradually introduced, making every stage bring a new surprise. Breakable platforms, cannons, obstacles, enemies, and optional collectibles fill the environments with possibilities to explore.

Checkpoints help you continue your adventure without losing all your progress, while collectibles scattered throughout the levels encourage players who want to explore every corner and completely master the challenges.

Observe the environment, plan your next move, create a bubble, use Ground Pound, blast yourself from cannons, and discover how far your creativity can take you.

Jump, pop, smash, and master every level!
